_about: First-language population per FHB language (each person counted once) — Joshua Project people-group data, summed by projects/fhb-nt-only-research/coverage.py (2026-09-21). Kevin 2026-09-21: the public reach metric is UNIQUE first-language coverage, never raw reach (which double-counts multilingual speakers). Nigerian Pidgin is 0 because it is almost entirely a second language. WORLD is the population the percentage is taken against. rosterTotal is the same sum over the full 80-language roster.
